What makes it worth a closer look?

A simple format for a daily routine

ProDentim is marketed as a chewable oral probiotic supplement. It combines several probiotic strains in a chewable format. It is a supplement, not a substitute for brushing, flossing, or dental care.

01

Chewable convenience

A chewable tablet that can be easier to fit into a daily routine.

02

Multi-strain blend

According to the seller, the blend includes L. reuteri, L. paracasei, and B. lactis BL-04, totaling 3.5 billion CFU per tablet.

The formula at a glance

Understand the formula before comparing prices

The seller lists probiotic strains alongside other ingredients, including inulin, malic acid, tricalcium phosphate, and peppermint. Check the current ingredient label before ordering.

  • Lactobacillus reuteri: researched in some oral health settings.
  • Lactobacillus paracasei: investigated for its relationship with oral bacteria.
  • Bifidobacterium lactis BL-04: researched more broadly for microbiome support; oral-specific evidence is less established.
Worth knowing: Research into individual strains does not establish that the complete ProDentim product treats gum disease, cavities or other conditions. Supplements do not replace brushing, flossing or regular dental visits.

Quick answers

Frequently asked questions

Is The Dorale the seller of ProDentim?

No. The Dorale is an independent affiliate information site. All ordering and payment take place on the linked seller's website; we may receive a commission.

Does ProDentim replace dental care?

No. It should not replace routine brushing, flossing, regular dental appointments, or prescribed care. The overall product has not been established as a treatment for oral disease.

Are the prices on this page guaranteed?

No. We display package examples from a supplier-provided presentation. The seller's live checkout controls final price, taxes, shipping and availability.

What about the money-back guarantee?

The supplied seller materials advertise a 60-day money-back guarantee. Please review the current written refund policy and conditions directly on the seller's website before purchasing.

Can anyone take this supplement?

Not necessarily. Review the ingredients and consult an appropriate healthcare professional before using supplements, particularly if you have health conditions, take medication, or are pregnant or nursing.
